verdict.rationale: Unleash documents metrics-driven automation — progressing rollout milestones or triggering safeguards (pause/disable) automatically when thresholds are crossed — which is a real background automation running without manual intervention, and its MCP integration lets AI agents create/manage flags. However this automation is narrowly scoped to release/rollout progression rather than a general-purpose agentic automation framework, and there's no evidence of scheduling arbitrary autonomous agent tasks beyond flag rollout safeguards. Missing for 10: evidence of broader autonomous task scheduling beyond rollout thresholds, independent corroboration of the impact-metrics automation working in production, and confirmation the MCP server itself can trigger these automations autonomously rather than just via API calls.
